_evidence: Car-record overlay for the 0x0042b17e family (0x42b27b, 0x42b318, 0x42b60f, 0x42b6c2): dword +0x1b8 is a track-segment pointer (0x42b6c2 uses it in place of the car's current segment +0x1c after 0x406123, and every reader compares it unsigned with the pit start [0x891500] then adds the record step [0x603e9c] and clamps at the pit end [0x866ef8] / wraps by [0x866ec4] at the lap end [0x866ecc]); dword +0x1c is the car's current segment (as car_0043c677 / cars_0066fef0). Both are record addresses 0x8943a0+k*0x160, k 0..29, the same record domain ring_008943a0 draws for its positions, so the pointer falls below and above the pit start and, after the step, both sides of the lap end / pit end. With ring_008943a0 geometry (lap end 4..26, pit end 1..32, wrap 1..4 records <= lap end) the stepped record is always 0..32: reads of +0x16/+0x51/+0x44 and the 0x4035c3/0x431ffb/0x40404c callees stay inside the ring array (records past 31 are plain image data). Compose after car_00431ffb+car_004035c3 (random background, +0x7e/+0xfd/+0x294/+0x1a0).
